settings.heading: Hydrogen Peroxide
settings.title: To Whiten
settings.text: A powerful whitening agent, Hydrogen Peroxide absorbs into your outer teeth and oxidizes with your teeth’s outermost layer, turning any stains & discoloration white.

settings.heading: Sodium Bicarbonate
settings.title: To Whiten
settings.text: A sensitivity-free whitening agent, Sodium Bicarbonate absorbs into your outer teeth and oxidizes with your teeth’s outermost layer, turning stains & discoloration white.

settings.heading: Glycerin
settings.title: To Moisturize
settings.text: A natural moisturizer, Glycerin rehydrates your teeth that loses moisture during the whitening process, protecting the enamel from decay and pH imbalance from dryness.

settings.heading: Ingredients That Work {For You}
settings.text: Clinically tested ingredients backed by science.
